text:
Ken: Quick heads-up — scheduled users_profiles schema migration TOMORROW 02:00 UTC. Dual-write window 02:00–03:00 UTC. Primary goals: minimal read disruption, backfill after window, rollback readiness. Need: deploy owner, smoke owner, DB on-call, and runbook link. cc @sam @taylor

Deploy-bot: slot reserved for 02:00 UTC by @ken. CID: slot-4921. (automated)

Sam: I can own smoke tests. What's the expected smoke checklist and how long should the basic canary run be?

Taylor: Est backfill ~25m for historical rows (50M) on replica, but that's sensitive to IO. We'll do prefix-batched backfill after dual-write if green. Canary run: 5–10m minimal traffic with 5 sample writes/reads.

pg-admin: Replication lag threshold: 60s. If >60s sustained for >5m during dual-write, abort and rollback dual-write. Rollback steps in runbook: flip writes back to old schema, ensure read paths validated, then coordinate backfill reschedule. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/users_profiles_migration (internal)

Sam: Basic smoke checklist I'm going to add:
1) Check /health on primary and replica
2) Run sample write -> read cycle (user creation -> profile read)
3) Confirm schema migrations present on replicas
4) Quick sanity query counts

Sample quick-check snippet:
```sql
-- quick migrated count check
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users_profiles WHERE migrated = true;
```

Ken: Who's coordinating rollback if we hit lag? @taylor? Also want a Kibana watcher + alerts on the channel.

Taylor: I'll coordinate rollback and trigger abort if needed. I'll start preflight canary at 01:30 UTC to warm caches and confirm query plans. Please make sure the metrics dashboard is up.

Ken: Assigning roles: slot owner: @ken; smoke lead: @sam; rollback lead: @taylor; DB on-call: @pg-admin; Kibana watcher: @jen. I'll post final preflight reminder at 23:00 UTC today.

jen: I can watch Kibana & alerts during the window. I'll pin the dashboards and add alert thresholds: error rate > 0.5% and latency p95 > 800ms.

Deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: preflight notification at 23:00 UTC. Slot lock active for 02:00 UTC.

Sam: I'll add the smoke checklist to the runbook and drop the canary commands there. Will be on-call in the slot.

Ken: Great — pushing calendar invite now and updating the runbook with these assignments. Please ack here when you've added your checks. Thx team. :thumbsup:
